title: Gemini in Reasoning: Unveiling Commonsense in Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly defines and evaluates 'Moral Commonsense' as a reasoning domain, utilizes the 'ETHICS' dataset for 'moral and ethical reasoning' (Section 3.1), and categorizes 'Social and Ethical Reasoning' as a major commonsense category within its evaluation (Figure 1, Section 4.2). This indicates a significant focus on evaluating models' capabilities in ethical reasoning.
